# Baran Dasdemir - Professional Portfolio & IT Specialist

> Baran Dasdemir is an Information Technology Specialist and Software Developer specializing in Web Development, Mobile App Development, SaaS Products, and AI Integration.

## About
Baran Dasdemir is a multi-disciplinary IT Specialist who builds modern, scalable web and mobile applications. Expert in .NET Clean Architecture, ASP.NET Core MVC, and Cybersecurity best practices. He is passionate about AI-powered solutions, real-time systems, and advanced software engineering.

## Technical Stack
- Backend: .NET 9/10, ASP.NET Core MVC, Web API, Entity Framework Core, Clean Architecture, N TİER
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), Bootstrap 5
- AI & Real-time: Groq AI, RAG Systems, SignalR
- Database: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis
- Infrastructure: IT Management, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
- Security: OAuth 2.0, 2FA, JWT, OWASP Hardening
